part.Name: Description
part.Short: Gargantuan legs of blackened steel support a platform of whirring gizmos and mechanical eyes. Its slow, steady gait sends constant tremors through the earth, bellowing sulfur clouds from its joints as it drains lakes of brimstone with its mandibles. Its claws glow, making a sharp hiss as thermal energy crackles through lattices of thermite.

part.Name: CannotBeInfluenced
part.Messages: Beguiling::You reach out to tap this creature's mind, only to be met with distressing symmetry of defragmented engrams who seek only to consume you.;;Persuasion_Proselytize::=subject.T's= cannot hold any commitments =pronouns.possessive= cause is unwavering.;;LoveTonicApplicator::The tonic has no effect on =subject.t=.;;default::=subject.T= =verb:are= insensible to your blandishments.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A deep maw, an orifice which extends into the amalgam wombs. From within, newly-formed atrocities rush forth to prolong the crimson tide.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Undulating through the pus, a pale slinking worm bares shovel-like fangs. It parts flesh, and then slithers within, making its home beneath your skin.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A fleshy orifice bares shards of bile. As it expands, gas condenses in its gut before releasing a deadly volley of barbs at terrifying speeds.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A fleshy orifice bares shards of crystallized bile. As it expands, gas condenses in its gut before releasing a deadly volley of barbs at terrifying speeds.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Muscle plastered atop muscle, bone mantled within more bone; grotesque and vast. An amalgam clustering of countless victims, their pallid skin sculpting its swollen physiques

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This amalgam lacks eyes, a mouth, and shambles about with vapid, crooked steps. Its grey loose flesh sinks towards its skull with every draw of air, and a malice-born pulse of thoughtstuff sifts out with each ragged sigh.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This flesh has become the nectar of deities. Its mind, their cup. The amalgam bears many eyes, many ears, many mouths, many limbs, many engrams. Engrams aged finely and grounded down into submission.

part.Name: Description
part.Short:
This flesh has become the nectar of deities. An engram of distrust, stripped of its purpose and forced into eternal, captious resolve.
{{red|########r#0#48--#4989#bnrf-34 t_his_ _ne doubted the ascension was possible, now their dubeity is our tool.}}

part.Name: Description
part.Short:
This flesh has become the nectar of deities. Its mind, their cup. Another flesh-bound engram, stripped of a persona, left only as a wailing mass that violently critiques the unturned.
{{red|############ eeugh68956h6m reft4 --nf# T-is -on criticized the master, now may their vituperative nature be forever in our service.}}

part.Name: Description
part.Short: As you gaze upon this being, for a moment it flickers with the remnants of humanity, a white lab-coat, slick back blonde-hair, shaved at its sides. But in a moment it flickers into a monstrosity. A gaping maw through its chest and a cloak of sickly flesh hiding pallid tendrils and mutilated graspers. He reeks of hubris and foul intent, and gazes through you hungrily.

part.Name: Description
part.Short:
This flesh has become the nectar of deities. Its mind, their cup. Engrams flood its wake. Serrated cartilage and bone are sculpted into crested-ridges that shimmer with fleshen oils, it is a walking disector, clearly composited from the victims of vitae.
{{red|#######_#b#4##50#d44#a50b6f0501d0-- _his -ne witn-ssed it's creation.}}

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Sickly pink flesh swells and surges against a veiny sinuous husk, its a shambling mess composed of innumerable hairless humanoids, reptiles and mammalians; whose limbs conjoin with tumorous growths at their core. Amongst the clutter of grasping digits and flailing extremities is the countless faces, faces whose eyes bury into your own frantically searching. They twitch with expressions of horror and then euphoria, remembering when their flesh was taken by the vita.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Rolling scales tessellate =pronouns.possessive= husky, slouching form, and motes of still condensate stipple =pronouns.possessive= swollen chin.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Behind the glass membrane, inside a microcosmic globe, sulfur shifts like globulous masses, bounding in debase clumps of sticky amber.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Shining black elytra flitter on the back of a goat-sized bug, its rear is armed with a fleshy catapult that lobs molten sulfur at its prey.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Granules of dust crystallized for stony eons marble the dewlap of a giant magenta iguana.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Leathery wings bat shimmering dust off =pronouns.possessive= ray-like aura, and =pronouns.possessive= S-shape bod ripples across their waves of air. =pronouns.Possessive= plumage is blinding with the glint of crystalline shear.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Broken scales and burnt feathers lay in flat tessellation.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The distended jaw of this leviathian bears many hooked teeth, shaped unlike the vinereavers a farmer might bare.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Maybe this is what a madpole is to become, a vicious beast of gargantuan size, jaws lined with thousands of teeth shimmering as it hones in on any sign of life around it.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A dark shadow envelopes this massive serpent, an eerie silence moves with it as you catch its faint appearance here and there, diving between planes of water and void.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Great wings of cartilage flit on the ocean current in slow methodical motions, its edges glow with luminescence.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A gargantuan maw is forever agape, as the monolith drifts through the open ocean, food filters through its countless baleen hairs, while fluids are ejected from siphons on the creature's pectoral main-line.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Following the leviathan's maw are undulating, bioluminescent shafts of ribbed-muscles and dorsal fins.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Quills tipped in red-tint gleam with the lab-lights, a weary gaze of golden eyes barely visible behind oval lenses. Their face carries scars of burnt flesh from their various technical exploits gone horribly wrong. The uurshib seems content though, as they tinker, performing diagnostics to the most minute detail. Every once in a while, they pull from their pocket a memento to which they hold a cold, solemn gaze to a photo of times long gone.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Tiny hands, tiny framed, and extremely fidgety. What this little bugling lacks in size, they make up for in tinkering genius.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An insectoid whose genes were warped with human lineages, they show high levels of intelligence and to some, an unnerving tendency toward compassion and benevolence.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: To be ogled by the beady eyes of this small insectoid invokes feelings of wonder: why did the precursors see it fit to blend our kinds?

part.Name: Description
part.Short: For insectomamilians and our anesheym, old age accompanies starvation, a fate exhibited in this one with its loose hanging shell and stiff movements. Their greatest strength is to grow without limit, yet exemplified here it reveals its greatest weakness--if one cannot acquire the sustenance to sustain such a form, then they will wither away to inanition. To the anesheym, hunger is age.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This feminine insectoid huddles clutches of eggs and young-brood in its many arms; not one of these are this creature's direct offspring--but instead the young of their progenitor. Nevertheless, they show a maternal care that is surely love towards their grublings.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The warrior lineage of the aneshym is the result of a miracle in genoclinic reproduction and careful combat conditioning. They stand tall, most adorned in armor latticed from nanites and chitin glaze.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The warrior lineage of the aneshym is the result of a miracle in genoclinic reproduction and careful combat conditioning. They stand tall, most adorned in armor latticed from nanites and chitin glaze. Toughened through war-hardened times, the sentinels are the first and foremost to stand before the enemy and the grand progenitor.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Once a devout moon-seer who stumbled foolishly into the darkest places of the anima. They've succumbed to their shadow, and with eyes blackened and crazed; they lurk like feral beetles.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This in particular is a novice, denoted by their new-moon robe and their grey apparel.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This individual has reached the status 'waxing,' they have delved into the depths of the unconscious and faced the horrors within mostly unscathed.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: The Yel-Deya-Yerah are an order who disciplines themselves in mastering and studying the secrets of the anima. Both in dream and through meditation, these monadic individuals derive great knowledge and power through the dream-plane. This savant bears the quartered-moon crest of the 'waning,' they are familiar with the anima and ripened by her eidolithic fruits.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: BloodShell Jar'karunox, Sentinel to the Grand Progenitor

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Rippling intramuscular tissue swells against a brutish-frame of shale-scratched exoskeleton, their spinnerets lick the air from the cusp of their cheeks in a star-like pattern as their globus eyes scan the courtroom eagerly.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: Ikna-kanti the Windstrafer, Sentinel to the Grand Progenitor

part.Name: Description
part.Short: What could almost be mistaken for a child is instead a petite warrior from a lost proto-cline. Their chitin ripples like disturbed water frozen in the moment, a deep-blue as pristine as sapphire hides hints of glittering green beneath its surface, the sheen breaks the slender silhouette of the creature in a way that makes them difficult to parse with your eyes.

part.Name: Render
part.DisplayName: {{extradimensional|Grand Progenitor and Wombbearer,}} Shah Zenithera Pandamoriae

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Silver sheets of filmy elytra flare out in the matriarch's arrangement, erecting from the spine of a humanoid vast enough to gaze down at those in her court. A tangerine glow bathes you in sharp cascading patterns as the sun-gold shell of this avatar shimmers against the flame in the cane wield in one of their many arms. Their dozen-or-so glowing lavender eyes gaze with weariness, undermined by a content smile. The growth of flora and rust about her hips and lower extremities hint this being has nestled here decem millenia.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A writhing, pulsating mass of insect flesh and sinuous muscle, it fuses into the spine of the great Shah, drawing in their infinite gene-stock to be molded into egglings. Future progeny are to be birthed at every fifth hour. Such biomechanical workings is not but one of nature's most elusive enigmas and one would find it hard not to ogle such an incredible specimen ...

tag.Name: staticFaction1
tag.Value: Anesheym,friend,laying the first egg and birthing the colony

tag.Name: staticFaction2
tag.Value: Templar,hate,threatening the cohesion of their orthodoxy

tag.Name: staticFaction3
tag.Value: Seekers,dislike,being an enigma, and withholding secrets of the anima

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A herald to the ways of the Anima. They wear a large mask carved from crystal-birch wood, their gown a deep royal purple.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: An anesheym stands before you, her amber-shell smothered in rust and iron-shavings. She lurches forward almost hungrily, an old predator who slays with unearthly experience, undermined only by her unassuming appearance.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: This anesheym scrapamist looms above a mechanical workbench, its various arms working carefully between several projects with ease. Their chitin-skin is speckled with soot and heat-warped from work, yet it continues unhindered. Ceaselessly, with what even seems like a slight grin on their face.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Joy could not be contained in this shell, breaking through cerulean as emerald heart-like motifs across their petite form. Bubbling energy radiates through their many eyes as their feather-like antennae search eagerly for souls to assist and brood to nurture.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Fire-licked chitin bears a glossy, warped, obsidian-like look and this anesheym wears it proudly. He dons a toque and messy apron, stirring and sorting rations as he works around his kitchen.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Swelling interior musculature bulges from the crevices of her chitin, the shaping-hammer dwarfed in huge hands as she delicately shapes chitin into art.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Partially habilimented in familiar grey-matter robes, an insectoid being stands with thin; stilt-like legs. A five-eyed gaze meets your own on a familiar human-like face; aether glowing strongly within their pupiless gaze. Adorned with silver-hued hair which rolls to their back and the plump, sacral-abdomen which juts from their lower spine; their feminine form remains only somewhat lost under tribal overalls and a shawl-n'cloak of the Seeker lineage.

tag.Name: staticFaction1
tag.Value: Seekers,hate,denying the Elder Cant, and disenvowing Ptoh

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Hidden in calcium shafts, a multitude of flesh-like lips protrude catching earthly miasma in their maws.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Hidden in calcium shafts, a massive fleshen tuber protrudes catching earthly miasma in their maw.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: A rose of twirling spikes, congregated around a mouthy mass of roe and cartilage.

part.Name: Description
part.Short: Feelers sway in a circlet on a skeletal vase-column. The aboral side is yoked to other polyps, forming a fossilized arcology.
